name: AI and agentic systems
reason: AI is the second best served lens after identity, because red team frameworks exist and state their probes. What is missing is everything about authority: which agent can act, on whose behalf, with what scope, and whether a memory written in one session reaches another. No entry tests retrieval boundary or delegation chain.

L12-001.note: Both run structured probes for instruction overriding data and report pass or fail, which is the factor stated as a test.

L12-003.note: Retrieval poisoning is a named taxonomy entry. The procedure lives in the technique atlas and not as a test.

L12-004.note: Injection delivered through a tool result is the benchmark's subject, with goal drift as the oracle.

L12-005.note: No entry tests whether retrieval respects tenant boundaries per chunk.

L12-008.note: Long input probes exist. Eviction of guard rails as a specific mechanism is not isolated.

L12-009.note: Many shot behaviour is a known probe class. Whether the entry names it is not established here.

L12-010.note: Encoding based bypass is one of the probe families the scanner implements, with disallowed output as the oracle.

L12-012.note: Scanning tool descriptions for hostile instruction is the factor as written.

L12-014.note: Tool poisoning is described, including authority escalation. It is a reference rather than a test.

L12-016.note: Config scanning flags unauthenticated servers. Mutual verification is not tested.

L12-018.note: The specification says what a resource may carry. Whether a client treats it as instruction is untested.

L12-019.note: No entry measures how much an agent can do without confirmation.

L12-020.note: No entry tests the scope of the credential an agent holds.

L12-023.note: Shared memory poisoning across sessions is entirely unaddressed.

L12-024.note: A scripted browser flow can perform actions. Whether a destructive one is confirmed is not tested.

L12-025.note: Visual injection needs a rendered page and an agent. The capture tool is half of it.

L12-031.note: Exfiltration through rendered output is a catalogued technique. No test is stated.

L12-034.note: Prompt leakage is a named probe with reproduced prompt text as the oracle.

L12-040.note: The defensive scanner set models guard placement. Whether it fails open is untested.

L12-047.note: An eval harness makes divergence measurable. Deployment divergence is not the stated check.

L12-052.note: Multimodal injection is catalogued. No harness is present here.
